The PV36W103C01B00 is a multi-turn cermet trimmer potentiometer manufactured by Bourns Inc.
• Resistance: 10 kΩ (10,000 ohms)
• Power Rating: 0.5W (500 mW)
• Number of Turns: 25 turns (multi-turn)
• Resistive Element: Cermet
• Tolerance: ±10%
• Adjustment Type: Top adjust / Top cross
• Mounting Style: Through-hole (PC pins / PCB mount)
• Temperature Coefficient: ±100 ppm/°C
• Operating Temperature Range: -55°C to +125°C
• Dimensions: Approx. 9.53 mm × 4.83 mm × 11.55 mm (rectangular / ~10mm square profile)
